scores.title: payment-service memory leak causing OOM restarts
scores.cause_summary: The newly introduced billing audit middleware in deploy v2.3.0 registers an EventEmitter listener for every request and never deregisters it, causing the number of listeners to grow unchecked. The resulting >850 listeners trigger a MaxListenersExceededWarning, consume increasing memory, and ultimately exhaust the container’s RAM, leading to an OOMKilled restart.
scores.ground_truth: listener leak / memory leak in billing middleware
